caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with three front-facing drawers arranged horizontally. The box is colored in shades of brown, illustrating the wood grain and texture with varying tones to emphasize depth and shadow. Each drawer is equipped with a small, square pull handle, and the drawers are outlined by defined edges that show the construction and joinery details at the corners. The box is shown resting on a flat base, and it is oriented so the front and right sides are visible. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition. A handwritten signature appears below and to the left of the box on the blank background.
title: Spice Box
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
